title: CFSE and spin-state comparison
basic_overview: CFSE quantifies d-electron stabilisation in a ligand field; pairing energy must be treated separately when required.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. d count. 2. Geometry. 3. Spin state. 4. Occupancy. 5. CFSE. 6. Add pairing term only if requested.
extra_info_content.factors: CFSE is not the total energy of a complex.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
